objective: Preallocate Fusion transaction write buffers for the first write operation.

tasks.title: Preallocate Fusion transaction write buffer
tasks.result: FusionTransaction initialization now reserves capacity for the first buffered write.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The initial write-buffer capacity is 1 because most write transactions push at least one put or delete entry before commit.

The optimization only changes initial Vec allocation for the transaction write buffer; read timestamps, write ordering, conflict checks, WAL entries, memtable updates, and scan/count visibility are unchanged.
The sql_dml regression emitted an existing SSTable retry warning after the passing result; the command exited successfully.
